summary: PR 7399 refactored AVM modules to source telemetry prefixes from their adjacent metadata.json. It merged without recorded reviews.
proposed: Telemetry prefixes should come from module metadata rather than being hard-coded in each main.bicep.
changed: 542 telemetry-implementing modules now use var telemetryIdPrefix = loadJsonContent('metadata.json', 'telemetryIdPrefix') and name their avmTelemetry deployment from it, with 546 main.json files regenerated. The scaffold and compliance checks were updated, and four source/metadata discrepancies (document-knowledge-mining, devcenter, network-connection, project) were reconciled to the published index identifiers, changing those four deployment names.
rejected: Module versions and per-module changelogs were deliberately left unchanged for this mechanical backfill.
shipped: The metadata-driven telemetry prefix change merged in one commit, with 543 changed avmTelemetry resources and 543 added telemetryIdPrefix variables in the deltas.
